text: Tallowood Health Network is increasing its paid parental leave from 1 January 2027. Primary carers will get 18 weeks at full pay, up from 12, and secondary carers will get 4 weeks, up from 2. Leave can now be split into up to three blocks, provided it is taken within 24 months of birth or adoption. The increase applies to children born or placed on or after 1 January 2027, and staff need 12 months' continuous service (casuals need 12 months of regular work). Superannuation will be paid on the government-funded portion for primary carers. Applications are due at least 10 weeks before leave starts, via the staff portal. Information sessions are on 5 and 19 November at 12:30pm.
